name: Ca ATPase
equation: ATP + Ca2+ + H2O --> ADP + Ca2+ + H+ + Pi

name: sn-glycerol-3-phosphate:ubiquinone oxidoreductase
equation: sn-glycerol-3-phosphate + ubiquinone --> DHAP + ubiquinol

name: ATP binding cassette subfamily D ((3R)-phytanoyl-CoA)
equation: ATP + 2 H2O + (3R)-phytanoyl-CoA <=> ADP + CoA + 2 H+ + (3R)-phytanic acid + Pi

name: (R)-Lactate:ferricytochrome-c 2-oxidoreductase
equation: D-lactate + 2 ferricytochrome C --> 2 ferrocytochrome C + 2 H+ + pyruvate

name: sulfite:ferricytochrome-c oxidoreductase
equation: 2 ferricytochrome C + H2O + sulfite --> 2 ferrocytochrome C + 2 H+ + sulfate

name: Absorption Or Uptake of 13-Docosenoic Acid into Cells
equation: ATP + cis-erucic acid + CoA --> AMP + PPi + 13-docosenoyl-CoA

name: NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase (alpha-tocopheryl quinone)
equation: alpha-tocopheryl quinone + 5 H+ + NADH --> alpha-tocopheryl hydroquinone + 4 H+ + NAD+

name: Uptake of Vaccenic Acid
equation: ATP + cis-vaccenic acid + CoA --> AMP + PPi + 11-octadecenoyl-CoA

name: Transport of Phytanoylcoa from Cytosol to Peroxisomes

name: Uptake of Linoleic Acid
equation: ATP + CoA + linoleate --> AMP + linoleoyl-CoA + PPi

name: Uptake of Octadecenoate
equation: ATP + CoA + oleate --> AMP + oleoyl-CoA + PPi

name: Transport of Hexadecanoate
equation: ATP + CoA + palmitate --> AMP + palmitoyl-CoA + PPi

name: heparan-alpha-glucosaminide N-acetyltransferase (acetyl-CoA)

name: heparan-alpha-glucosaminide N-acetyltransferase (acetyl-CoA)
equation: acetyl-CoA + heparan sulfate, degradation product 19 --> CoA + H+ + heparan sulfate, degradation product 20

name: hyaluronan synthase (UDP-glucuronate)
equation: UDP-glucuronate + UDP-N-acetylglucosamine --> 2 H+ + hyaluronan biosynthesis, precursor 1 + 2 UDP

name: hyaluronan synthase (hyaluronan biosynthesis, precursor 1)
equation: hyaluronan biosynthesis, precursor 1 + UDP-glucuronate + UDP-N-acetylglucosamine --> 2 H+ + hyaluronate + 2 UDP

name: Uptake of Arachidate
equation: ATP + CoA + eicosanoate --> AMP + eicosanoyl-CoA + PPi

name: (S)-Lactate:ferricytochrome-c 2-oxidoreductase
equation: 2 ferricytochrome C + L-lactate --> 2 ferrocytochrome C + 2 H+ + pyruvate

name: gamma-glutamyltransferase (alanine)
equation: alanine + GSH --> (5-L-glutamyl)-L-amino acid + cys-gly

name: gamma-glutamylcyclotransferase ((5-L-glutamyl)-L-amino acid)
equation: (5-L-glutamyl)-L-amino acid --> 5-oxoproline + alanine

name: Uptake of Octadecanoate (N-C18:0)
equation: ATP + CoA + stearate --> AMP + PPi + stearoyl-CoA

name: Uptake of Hexadecanoate
equation: ATP + CoA + myristic acid --> AMP + myristoyl-CoA + PPi

name: Arachidonate (N-C18:1) Transport by FATP
equation: arachidonate + ATP + CoA --> AMP + arachidonyl-CoA + PPi

name: Lignocerate Transport by FATP
equation: ATP + CoA + lignocerate --> AMP + PPi + tetracosanoyl-CoA

name: transport of biomass (cytosol to extracellular)
equation: biomass --> biomass

name: MAR20167
equation: ubiquinone + FMNH2 <=> FMN + ubiquinol

name: Reduction of alpha-tocopheryl quinone by Complex III
equation: alpha-tocopheryl quinone + 2 ferricytochrome C + 5 H+ --> alpha-tocopheryl hydroquinone + 2 ferrocytochrome C + 4 H+
